name: htm-escape-tracker
description: Hour To Midnight escape room session tracker with Google Sheets sync, deployed on Raspberry Pi 4B

scripts.deploy: node -c server.js && scp server.js index.html home.html login.html csv-downloads.html mytho@192.168.0.124:/home/mytho/escape-room-tracker/ && ssh mytho@192.168.0.124 "pm2 restart htm-server && pm2 logs htm-server --lines 20"
